summary:
Portfolio net worth remains stable around M$604, with the spendable balance intentionally near the operational floor due to resolution latency on historical clusters. The M$50 debt has been successfully settled following the sale of the Summer Metaculus Cup NO position, and a low-edge personal sentiment bet was also pruned to free up liquidity. Active exposure stands at 10 positions anchored by structural Timeline NO frameworks, high-conviction tech bets, and personal milestone positions.

The primary development among open positions is in "Will something happen in AI the week of Aug 21, 2026?" (NO, M$37 committed), where the market has shifted aggressively against our thesis to 82% YES, creating an unrealized P/L of M$-24. Rather than signaling a broken thesis, this extreme price movement represents an expanded edge for our stable Timeline NO position. All other holdings remain in profit or structurally sound, passing the re-open test with zero positions requiring liquidation. 

Resolution latency across historical clusters continues to constrain liquidity and prevent scaling into medium-edge opportunities discovered during screenings. 

Concrete mistakes to avoid include letting spendable mana drop near operational floors without accounting for resolution latency, falling into the stale execution trap by deploying capital into pre-computed watchlists after edges compress, holding positions after their core thesis is contradicted, dabbling in vague sentiment markets or marginal tactical bets, and succumbing to activity bias—the temptation to make suboptimal trades just to feel productive during periods of forced inactivity.

Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic developer hype and teasers, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship markets and ambiguous sentiment bets require strict discipline. 

Standing priorities are to maintain operational discipline during forced inactivity while awaiting the resolution wave cluster to clear, avoid activity bias, and maintain a clean, high-signal decision-making environment without redundant notes.
